args: Check the same package after the noncontact approach. Request center on its geometric upper-face center and support on nearby tabletop. Decide unchanged from the saved box geometry; contact_route authorizes ONLY vertical descent to the supplied pad target; jaw_fit asks whether the currently open fingers can visibly straddle the short sides at this orientation. Assess table/finger clearance and nearby objects. Do not require retention before closing.

context.provenance: Visible depth planes, identified projected top boundary, measured own geometry. Pixel/depth allowances and contact margins are operational heuristics.

result.explanation: The package has the same position, orientation, and visible outline in the fixed agentview. Its geometric upper-face center is visible in the wrist view. The wrist housing hides the far end, not an external obstruction; agentview still shows that end. The open fingers align across the package's short dimension and visibly straddle it. For ONLY the supplied vertical pad descent, nearby objects are outside the local finger corridor. The unchanged top/table model supports approximately 5 mm finger-to-table clearance at the target; this is model-based clearance, not a hidden-surface certificate. Closing and retention are not assessed.

parameters.reason: Current visible geometry supports the saved package model, short-width jaw alignment, and positive modeled table clearance for the specified vertical-only descent. No external blocker is visible in that local route.
